docs.title: Authentication
docs.text: The User Management API uses authenication with API key to secure access to its endpoints. This document explains how authentication works and how to use it correctly.

docs.title: Authentication Method
docs.text: The API uses authentication scheme where each request you sent to any API method must include a valid API token in the Token header of the request.

docs.title: Token Format
docs.text:
The API token is a unique string generated for your account and available in your user profile. It follows this format:

Token: YOUR_API_TOKEN

Note

No prefix is necessary.

docs.title: Obtaining the Token
docs.text:
1. Log in to your Conduit account
  2. Navigate to API Keys
  3. Copy the available token and store it securely

Important: You can request a new token from the Documentat manager if needed.

docs.title: Passing the Token
docs.text:
Include your API token in the Token header of every request:

Note

If not explicitly specified, test server address is used in the examples.

curl -X GET https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users \
  -H "Token: YOUR_API_TOKEN"

docs.title: cURL
docs.text:
curl -X GET https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users \
  -H "Token: YOUR_API_TOKEN"

docs.title: JavaScript
docs.text:
fetch('https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users', {
  method: 'GET',
  headers: {
    'Token': 'YOUR_API_TOKEN',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  }
})
.then(response => response.json())
.then(data => console.log(data));

docs.title: Python (Requests)
docs.text:
import requests

headers = {
    'Token': 'sk_live_abc123',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}

response = requests.get('https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users', headers=headers)
print(response.json())

docs.title: Node.js (Axios)
docs.text:
const axios = require('axios');

const headers = {
  'Token': 'YOUR_API_TOKEN',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
};

axios.get('https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users', { headers })
  .then(response => console.log(response.data));

docs.title: Environment Variable Example
docs.text:
# Set the environment variable
export API_TOKEN=YOUR_API_TOKEN

# Use it in your request
curl -X GET https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users \
  -H "Token: $API_TOKEN"

docs.title: 401 Unauthorized
docs.text:
Returned when: - No token is provided - The token is invalid - The token has been revoked

{
  "code": 401,
  "message": "Ошибка авторизации: токен доступа указан неверно или доступ не авторизован"
}

docs.title: Testing with Test Tokens
docs.text:
For testing purposes, you can use test mode tokens. These tokens work with the test server and do not affect real data.

Token: YOUR_API_TOKEN

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text: This User Management API provides a set of endpoints for managing user accounts within the Documentat platform. The API adheres to the OpenAPI 3.0 specification and provides REST methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting user records.

docs.title: Target Audience
docs.text: This documentation is designed for Software Developers integrating user management functionality into their applications.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
The User Management API provides the following capabilities:

  • User Creation: Create new user accounts with complete profile information
  • User Retrieval: Fetch individual user details or list all users
  • User Updates: Modify user data through full (PUT) or partial (PATCH) updates
  • User Deletion: Remove specified user accounts
  • Error Handling: Error responses with descriptive codes and messages

docs.title: API Basics
docs.text:
• Base URL: One can opt from the test API https://api.documentat.io/api/devand production ready https://api.documentat.io/api/prod address
  • Authentication: API Key passed in the Token header of the API request
  • Data Format: JSON payload is used in all request and response bodies
  • Response Codes: Standard HTTP status codes for success and error conditions

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: To begin using the API, follow the Quickstart Guide to register and make your first API request.

docs.title: Quickstart
docs.text: This guide will help you get started with the User Management API. You'll learn how to register, obtain an API token, and make your first API request.

docs.title: Step 1: Register for API Access
docs.text:
To begin using the API, register for an account on the Documentat.io Platform.

  1. Visit the registration page
  2. Fill in your email address
  3. Obtain access to the site

docs.title: Step 2: Obtain Your API Token
docs.text:
After registration, obtain an API token to authenticate your requests to the User Management API.

  1. Log in to your Conduit account
  2. Navigate to API Keys
  3. Copy the available token and store it securely

Note: The API token is issued specifically to your developer account. Do not share it with other persons or post elsewhere.

docs.title: Step 3: Make Your First API Request
docs.text: With your API token ready, you can now make requests to the API. The token must be included in the Token header of each request.

docs.title: Example: List All Users
docs.text:
This example retrieves a list of all users in the system.

curl -X GET https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users \
  -H "Token: YOUR_API_TOKEN"

docs.title: Example: Create a New User
docs.text:
This example creates a new user with complete profile information.

curl -X POST https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users \
  -H "Token: YOUR_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "username": "johndoe",
    "email": "john.doe@example.com",
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "address": {
      "country": "USA",
      "city": "New York",
      "street": "5th Avenue",
      "house": "123"
    },
    "age": 30,
    "isEmployee": true,
    "accountStatus": "active"
  }'

docs.title: Example: Get User by ID
docs.text:
This example retrieves details for a specific user by their ID.

curl -X GET https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users/123 \
  -H "Token: YOUR_API_TOKEN"

docs.title: Example: Update a User
docs.text:
This example updates a user's information using a full update (PUT).

curl -X PUT https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users/123 \
  -H "Token: YOUR_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "username": "johndoe_updated",
    "email": "john.updated@example.com",
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "address": {
      "country": "USA",
      "city": "Boston",
      "street": "Boylston Street",
      "house": "456"
    },
    "age": 31,
    "isEmployee": true,
    "accountStatus": "active"
  }'

docs.title: Example: Partial User Update
docs.text:
This example updates only specific fields using a partial update (PATCH).

curl -X PATCH https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users/123 \
  -H "Token: YOUR_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "address": {
      "city": "Chicago"
    },
    "age": 32
  }'

docs.title: Example: Delete a User
docs.text:
This example deletes a user from the system.

curl -X DELETE https://api.documentat.io/api/dev/users/123 \
  -H "Token: YOUR_API_TOKEN"

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
If you encounter issues:

  1. Verify your API token is correct and not expired
  2. Ensure the Token header is correctly specifed
  3. Check the Responses section for common error codes for the method called
  4. Contact support for further assistance
